## 5. Regulation & Policy

**EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations enter application**

- **Date:** 2026-08-02
- **Primary source:** [European Commission guidance on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of AI systems](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/library/guidelines-transparency-obligations-providers-and-deployers-ai-systems)
- **Summary:** The Commission guidance marks Article 50 transparency duties applying from August 2, 2026. Covered areas include disclosure when users interact with AI systems, labeling of synthetic content and deepfakes, notices for emotion-recognition or biometric-categorization systems, and transparency around AI-generated public-interest content.
- **Why it matters:** This is an operational compliance date for AI providers and deployers in or serving the EU, independent of broader phased timelines for some high-risk AI Act obligations.

## 7. AI Workflows & Tactics

**Claude desktop “workspace OS” automation pattern**

- **Date:** 2026-08-02
- **Source:** [How I Use Claude Cowork to Automate 99% Of My Life](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cJ2QCyr3yzU)
- **Summary:** The workflow uses Claude’s desktop file access, folders, connectors, skills, and plugins to create repeatable task environments. The example system includes email triage, daily research briefs, personal tracking, and task management.
- **Setup:** Create a parent folder for Claude workspaces. Add subfolders by function, such as email, research, finance, content, or personal tracking. Put project-specific instructions and reference files in each folder. In Claude desktop, connect relevant apps such as Gmail, Notion, Google Calendar, or Canva. Add skills for repeated workflows such as content research or inbox triage. Run Claude inside the relevant folder so it has the right local context.
- **Available now:** Presented as available through Claude desktop features discussed in the video.
- **Why it matters:** The tactic is practical: it turns general-purpose chat into bounded, file-backed operating routines. The value is in reducing repeated prompting and constraining context by workflow.
